title: Destructive whole-day command can route through trip revision instead of confirmation
evidence: During baseline debugging, message '第二天全部清空。' rendered a production question card asking for Tokyo travel dates before the deterministic harness was extended to /api/trip/revise.
expected: Ask for explicit destructive confirmation and emit no mutation action until confirmed.

title: Trip replacement write is not atomic
evidence: saveTripPayload deletes TripDay, TripItem, and MapPin rows before recreating them, without wrapping the full replacement in prisma.$transaction.
expected: A DB failure during trip save should roll back all day/item/pin mutations.

title: AssistantAction add_item is not replay safe
evidence: itemFromInput generates ids with Date.now() and Math.random(), so the same assistant action can create duplicates on retry/resend.
expected: Assistant actions should carry stable ids or action ids and executor should be idempotent.

title: Partial AssistantAction skips are not clearly reported to the user
evidence: applyAssistantActions returns skippedCount, but the chat apply flow does not present a partial-failure summary for AssistantActions.
expected: Partial application should not look like full success.

title: Day-level itinerary operations are not represented as first-class actions
evidence: Current known action types cover item add/update/remove/reorder/replace_day and trip metadata, but not insert/delete/swap/move day.
expected: Support explicit day operations with confirmation and access validation.

title: Pronoun and ordinal item references lack a deterministic resolver
evidence: Requested cases such as '它', '剛剛加入的', and '第二個' rely on model interpretation and current context; no dedicated resolver was found in baseline coverage.
expected: Resolve references deterministically or ask clarification when ambiguous.

title: Forbidden current-trip writes can surface as generic 500 responses
evidence: The API baseline verifies User B cannot write User A's trip through /api/trips/current, but the route catches non-unauthorized errors as internal_error.
expected: Return a 403 permission response for forbidden writes without changing data.

title: Live AI quality metrics are not established
evidence: First baseline uses deterministic mocks and does not run the core cases three times against a live model.
expected: Record model name, success rate, action correctness, hallucination rate, memory correctness, state consistency, and flaky rate.

title: Empty-trip itinerary page requires onboarding dismissal before assertions
evidence: User B isolation test initially timed out waiting for editor/landing-card because a no-trip user sees an empty library and onboarding modal.
expected: Tests should dismiss onboarding and assert the empty library state directly.
